start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:method-do-it-completely on this request: add a pre-order page for a bakery, finished in one pass." It walks delete, owner, smallest-change, production and proof and hands back an answer and checks for each.
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Write what you are deciding, designing or building in plain words, for example "Add a pre-order page for a bakery".
2. Say "Run workflow:method-do-it-completely" with that request; the AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run.
3. The steps run in order: delete, owner, smallest-change, production, proof; each hands back an answer (at least 40 characters) and one short answer per named check.
4. Read proof last: it says what shows success or failure and the date it will be checked, so nothing is left for later.
